OBJECT Codeunit 50030 Formatting Guidelines
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=21.11.26;
    Time=12:00:00;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=TEST;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
  }
  CODE
  {
    local procedure FormatDemo@1(QtyP@1000 : Decimal;PriceP@1001 : Decimal);
    var
        TotalL@1002 : Decimal;
        IdxL@1003 : Integer;
    begin
      // CAL030, CAL031, CAL032, CAL033, CAL034: indentation, BEGIN, spacing, keywords, semicolons/blanks
      TotalL:=QtyP*PriceP;;


      // CAL031: single-line IF puts BEGIN on the same line
      if TotalL>0 then
      begin
          TotalL:=TotalL+1;
      end;

      // CAL031: multi-line IF puts BEGIN on the next line directly under IF
      if (QtyP>0) and
         (PriceP>0) then begin
        TotalL:=TotalL+PriceP;
      end;

      // CAL032: unary minus must not get extra space; commas/parens spaced properly
      IdxL := -1;
      MESSAGE( '%1, %2' ,TotalL ,IdxL );
    end;

    BEGIN
    END.
  }
}
